_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated drama by Kālidāsa in seven acts,
 in which king Duṣyanta marries Kaṇvaʼs foster daughter Śakuntalā by
 the Gāndharva form of marriage, forgets all about her owing to the curse
 of Durvāsas, but ultimately recollects, at the sight of the token-ring
 ({#aBijYAna#}) that he had duly married her; {#aBijYAnena smftA SakuntalA#}
 {#aBijYAnaSakuntalA#}; {#tAmaDikftya kftaM nAwakaM˚ SAkuntalam#}; (the reading
 {#˚SAkuntalam#} is grammatically indefensible).
